project.name: WQA Implementation — June 2026
project.primary_goal: Kickoff (WQA + report + plan, M1), technical fixes (M1), analytics setup (M1), content production (M3+), link building (M4+), monthly reporting throughout.

sprints.name: Sprint 1 (Kickoff)
sprints.notes: Kickoff phase: WQA → WQA Report → Project Plan. Auto-tracked deliverables flip to completed as each artifact lands.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 (Technical)
sprints.notes: Technical fixes — 404s, redirects, indexability. Month 1. Grouped by action type.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 (Local SEO)
sprints.notes: Local SEO foundation — GBP audit, citation cleanup, review velocity. Month 2 placeholders; expand on deep-dive.

sprints.name: Sprint 4 (Content)
sprints.notes: Content production Months 3+. Strategy/gap analysis first, then grouped metadata work + batched heavy rewrites by priority.

sprints.name: Sprint 5 (Links)
sprints.notes: Link building. Month 3 = strategy + plan. Months 4+ = monthly batches (URLs in description).

sprints.name: Sprint 6 (Reporting)
sprints.notes: Recurring monthly performance report sent to client at the end of each month. Serves as visual month-break in the Tasks view.

deliverables.name: WQA — Website Quality Audit
deliverables.description:
Strategic audit of the website covering technical SEO, content quality, and link foundation.
  · Run Screaming Frog crawl + Ahrefs site explorer pull
  · Classify every page (Keep / Improve / Consolidate / Remove)
  · Tag specific actions per page (Fix 404 / Rewrite / etc.)
  · Capture target pages + their backlink gaps
  · Strategist approval pass on every recommendation
Two outputs (same work stream):
  1. {slug}-wqa-data.xlsx — audit spreadsheet (4 tabs)
  2. {slug}-wqa-report.html — client-facing HTML deck (5 sections)
Auto-completes when BOTH the approvals JSON + HTML report exist on disk.

source.notes: Outputs xlsx audit spreadsheet + HTML client report.

deliverables.name: Project Plan (12-month engagement)
deliverables.description:
Build the structured project plan from the WQA approvals + target pages. Generates sprints + monthly deliverable schedule for the full engagement.
  · Sprints 2-6 (Technical / Local / Content / Links / Reporting)
  · Monthly batches + client check-ins
  · Per-deliverable owners, due dates, priorities
Output: {slug}-project-plan.json (exportable to ClickUp/Asana/Monday via export_project_plan.py). Auto-completed by build_project_plan.py.

source.notes: Auto-completed by build_project_plan.py on every regeneration.

deliverables.name: Content Strategy + gap analysis

deliverables.name: Analytics Audit — conversion tracking + measurement setup
deliverables.description:
Foundational analytics audit — verify the measurement layer is trustworthy before any monthly reporting is meaningful. Focus on conversion plumbing:
  · GA4 conversion events — firing reliably, flagged as conversions
  · Call-tracking integrations (WhatConverts / CallRail): DNI, attribution, event push-through
  · Form tracking — submission events, lead source attribution
  · CRM integration (HubSpot / Salesforce / Pipedrive) — sources tagged correctly
  · GA4 ↔ GSC link active
  · Cross-domain / subdomain tracking gaps
  · GBP Insights accessibility
  · Note any tracking holes that would invalidate monthly reports.

Output: short Loom + written summary of what's wired, what's broken, and what needs fixing before Month 1 reporting.

source.notes: Runs Month 1 right after the WQA. 10-day duration.

deliverables.name: WQA Refresh — Mid-engagement Audit (Month 6)
deliverables.description:
Re-run a mini-WQA to recalibrate the plan at Month 6.
  · Fresh SF crawl + Ahrefs pull
  · Compare current performance vs the initial WQA baseline
  · Score what's working (content/links/technical) and what's not
  · Update the next-6-months roadmap (or close-out report at M12)
  · Strategist-approval pass on any new recommendations
Output: WQA Refresh deck + revised plan (mid) or final close-out (end).

deliverables.name: Client Check-in — Month 2 (covers Month 1 performance)

  2. Analysis writeup: what moved and why, what to double down on, recommendations for next month's focus.
  3. Optional client call: offer a 30-min walkthrough; if declined, send the deck + analysis by email.
